page.notes: The running head is read as PROROGANDA; the printed word is doubtful ([?]). The scan shows a left-hand ink fragment and show-through from the facing page, which are left out. Marginal notes on the right are printed in fragments split by line breaks and are given as they stand. Several note fragments are uncertain and may need checking against the original. The first paragraph's opening word "proritet" is doubtful. The catchword "pulfare" is read as printed.
